newsitem.title: USA: U.S. weekly molasses report - Aug 4.
newsitem.headline: U.S. weekly molasses report - Aug 4.

text.p: Prices on sugarcane molasses were unchanged in the week ended August 2, USDA Market News said in their weekly National Molasses report. Molasses supplies are moderate and demand remains light. Domestic molasses usage is light to moderate.

According to USDA, slow seasonal demand from the livestock feeding industry, competition from Australian molasses on the world market, and reports of good U.S. crop conditions pressured molasses prices. Molasses prices continued to be supported by good dairy demand in the upper midwest.
